Definition: Gudgodah, a place in the Desert
BiblicalUsage: Gudgodah is a place in the Desert. In Deuteronomy 10:7, the text says "From thence they journeyed unto Gudgodah." It is a place, not a person, so there is no People profile for it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Gudgodah matters because God's story happened in real places, and Gudgodah is one of them.
